edges.quote: RARE DISEASE PRODUCTION Expanding therapeutic impact in rare bleeding and growth disorders

The passage describes the portfolio's performance and strategy but does not explicitly define 'RARE DISEASE PRODUCTION' as a distinct reporting segment in the financial or organizational sense required for the HAS_SEGMENT relation. It functions more as a category or business area description rather than a bound reporting segment entity.
